snippet.title: Sanity Break "Madness" Trailer
snippet.description:
Sanity Break available for $10 USD on Steam and Itch.io in Winter 2025

First trailer for Sanity Break.
Sanity Break is a First Person Survival Horror Rogue Like Rpg. Select your class, build your character, and reach your goal by the end of day 5... and don't go insane.

This trailer focuses on the Sanity/ Enemies/ and Horror aspect of the game. You have an internal sanity meter that you must maintain or the environment will change around you. Trial and error is this games MO. Learn from your mistakes, grow stronger, don't get caught by the various entities that roam the dungeons, and try not to lose your mind.
